drafted_from: tool:listen-to-sound-effects-and-find-clean-trims row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Rank my hits folder against the description a low hit and find the cleanest trim of the best one." It writes CATEGORIES.json for the hit category, runs the listener and reads back the trim it found.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads CATEGORIES.json and sound files on this computer and merges its findings into an OUT.json file.
instructions: 1. Put the sound files of each category in a folder, for example /work/sfx/hits/a.wav and /work/sfx/hits/b.wav.

3. Say "Listen to my sounds". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 <earshot python> -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/listen_to_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/categories.json /work/sfx/listen.json (add category names after it to do only those).
4. Read the last line, then open listen.json: each category lists its top candidates with trim [start, end], head_db, tail_db (at most -30), match z, describe, realness and measures.

worked_examples.title: A low tone and a high tone ranked for "a low hit"; the low one is trimmed clean
worked_examples.ask: Rank my hits folder for "a low hit" and find the cleanest trim of the best one.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_rank_then_whole_listening, stand-in earshot): /work/sfx/hits/a.wav is a 0.5 s 200 Hz tone with 0.1 s of silence either side, b.wav a 2000 Hz tone; categories.json is {"hit": {"folder": "/work/sfx/hits", "query": "a low hit", "kind": "event", "top": 1, "alts": ["a door"]}}. Command: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 python -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/listen_to_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/categories.json /work/sfx/listen.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"out": "/work/sfx/listen.json", "categories": 1}}. listen.json: hit has rank_summary "2 ranked" and one candidate, /work/sfx/hits/a.wav (rank_z 3.0), with trim [0.09, 0.615], head_db -240.0, tail_db -240.0 (a clean edge, at most -30), match_z 3.0, describe "a tone near 200 Hz", duration 0.525.
